absolute_risk_calibrated.blocking_gap: No baseline hazard is transported and no calibration gate has passed.
absolute_risk_calibrated.meaning: An absolute survival or response probability. Requires a transported baseline hazard and a passing calibration gate.

relative_prognostic_index.band_semantics: Exploratory definition only. The prespecified band stability gate failed, so no categorical band is emitted and none may be reconstructed from reference_percentile. Retained for audit reproduction of the failed gate.
relative_prognostic_index.band_suppression_statement: The categorical band is suppressed because its prespecified stability gate failed. No category is emitted, and a category must not be inferred from reference_percentile, z_rank, prognostic_log_hazard_index or relative_hazard_multiplier.
relative_prognostic_index.disclosure: Externally associated with overall survival in comparator cohorts. Relative prognostic index only. Not an absolute survival probability, treatment-benefit estimate, or therapy recommendation. Validated among week-15 survivors with positive estimable early PSA decline. A1-RSE precision gate failed: 66.5% versus 80%. The categorical band is suppressed because its prespecified stability gate failed.

gate.estimator: joint bootstrap of the reference cohort, B=2000

exploratory_band_definition.must_not_be_used_for: rendering a category, or inferring a category from any emitted continuous field
exploratory_band_definition.retained_for: audit reproduction of the failed gate

fit_precision_design.replicate_rejected_if: non-finite k_day, or fewer than 2 distinct days drawn
fit_precision_design.resampling_unit: distinct analysis day within the locked early window

relative_prognostic_index.fit_precision_semantics: fit_precision_status annotates the quality of this patient's rate estimate. It is an output-quality annotation, not a cohort filter: the frozen reference population was not filtered on precision and is unchanged. The uncertainty intervals propagate resampling of this patient's own analysis days only, holding the frozen coefficient and reference distribution fixed. They are not a joint interval and not a band activation gate.
relative_prognostic_index.interval_semantics: This interval propagates Cox coefficient uncertainty only. It does not include uncertainty in the patient's PSA-rate fit, reference CDF or assay measurements.
relative_prognostic_index.meaning: Hazard ratio relative to a reference patient at z_rank = 0, from a frozen external Cox coefficient and a frozen reference distribution.

treatment_predictive.blocking_gap: All released prostate cohorts are comparator/control arms, so no treatment-by-kinetics interaction is estimable.
treatment_predictive.meaning: A treatment-by-marker interaction supporting a therapy choice.

contract.ruo_scope: Research use only. Not validated for clinical decision-making. No calibrated score or probability is emitted by this axis.

reference_artifact.cdf_convention: Frozen empirical midrank plotting position F(k) = (L + E/2)/n with L = #{k_i < k} and E = #{k_i == k}. For a distinct value at 1-indexed rank r this equals (r - 0.5)/n, which is exactly the transformation the locked Cox model was fitted on. The naive i/n ECDF is deliberately NOT used: it would return 1.0 at the reference maximum and be inconsistent with the fitted coefficient.
reference_artifact.lower_extrapolation_policy: k below the lowest knot returns the lowest knot's plotting position 0.5/n. Never 0.
reference_artifact.upper_extrapolation_policy: k above the highest knot returns the highest knot's plotting position (n - 0.5)/n. Never 1.
validated_population_criteria: trial VENICE (independent external cohort; placebo + docetaxel + prednisone comparator arm)
at least three distinct PSA observations in the locked 0-105 day early window
positive, estimable first-order PSA decline rate (k_day > 0, finite)
survived through the week-15 landmark (os_weeks strictly greater than 15.0)
complete age_ge65 and ECOG covariates used by the locked Cox model

direction.statement: Higher k_day (faster PSA elimination) maps to a higher reference percentile, a higher z_rank, a lower prognostic log hazard index and a lower relative hazard multiplier. The reverse mapping is structurally impossible while beta < 0.

limitations_emitted_with_every_payload: Relative prognostic index only; not an absolute survival probability.
Not a treatment-benefit estimate and not a therapy recommendation.
No absolute-risk calibration exists; no baseline hazard is transported.
Derived from comparator/control arms only, so no treatment-by-kinetics interaction is estimable and treatment prediction is out of scope.
A1-RSE precision gate failed: 66.5% versus 80% with RSE<0.5.
Defined only among week-15 survivors with a positive estimable early PSA decline; other patients fail closed with a typed reason.

The prespecified band stability gate FAILED: quartile-knot concordance 0.6662 against a required 0.90 in the B6 joint bootstrap (B=2000). The same bootstrap gave concordance 0.9456 on the full knot grid and 96.7% population-wide, but only 49-51% for values sitting exactly on the 0.25 / 0.75 cut points; the prespecified evaluation is the quartile-knot one, and the higher figures do not replace it. relative_prognostic_band is therefore null on every code path and no category may be inferred from any emitted continuous field.

coefficient_conditional_relative_hazard_interval propagates Cox coefficient uncertainty only. It does not include uncertainty in the patient's PSA-rate fit, reference CDF or assay measurements, and it is not a patient-level confidence interval. Its width is proportional to |z_rank|, so it approaches zero at the reference median.

percentile_uncertainty_interval, k_day_uncertainty_interval and multiplier_uncertainty_interval propagate resampling of this patient's own analysis days only, holding the frozen coefficient and reference distribution fixed. Neither interval emitted by this service is a joint interval over all three uncertainty components.

In the frozen reference cohort the individual-rate component was the widest of the three components for 292 of 412 patients with estimable uncertainty, and the median joint interval was about twice the width of the coefficient-only interval.

fit_precision_status is an output-quality annotation, not a cohort filter. The n=446 frozen reference population is unchanged and was not filtered on fit precision. In that population only 12.6% of patients were RELIABLE.

An unstable resampled decline sign fails closed with reason UNSTABLE_DECLINE_SIGN. Fewer than four distinct analysis days yields fit_precision_status INSUFFICIENT_FOR_UNCERTAINTY, in which case the point index is still served and every uncertainty field is null.
The reference distribution is a single external trial (VENICE); portability of a within-trial rank transform to other populations is untested.

ruo: Research use only. Not validated for clinical decision-making. No calibrated score or probability is emitted by this axis.
